SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.REQUEST_ID, R.SCORE, R.CONTENT, TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT, R.USER_NO, U.NAME AS USER_NAME, R.FIXER_NO, F.NAME AS FIXER_NAME FROM REVIEW R JOIN USERS U ON R.USER_NO = U.USER_NO JOIN USERS F ON R.FIXER_NO = F.USER_NO
ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW R JOIN USERS U ON R.USER_NO = U.USER_NO JOIN USERS F ON R.FIXER_NO = F.USER_NO

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.REQUEST_ID, R.SCORE, R.CONTENT, TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, R.USER_NO, U.NAME AS USER_NAME, R.FIXER_NO, F.NAME AS FIXER_NAME FROM REVIEW R JOIN USERS U ON R.USER_NO = U.USER_NO JOIN USERS F ON R.FIXER_NO = F.USER_NO WHERE R.REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId}

SELECT F.USER_NO, F.USER_ID, F.NAME, ROUND(AVG(R.SCORE), 1) AS AVG_SCORE, COUNT(R.REVIEW_ID) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM REVIEW R JOIN USERS F ON R.FIXER_NO = F.USER_NO GROUP BY F.USER_NO, F.USER_ID, F.NAME HAVING AVG(R.SCORE) < 3.0 ORDER BY AVG(R.SCORE) ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SANCTION (TARGET_NO, SANCTION_TYPE, SANCTION_REASON, START_AT, END_AT, ADMIN_ID) VALUES (#{targetNo}, 'WARNING', #{reason}, SYSTIMESTAMP, NULL, #{adminId})
